name: Bug report

title: "[BUG] "
labels: bug
assignees: ''

## Problem and expected behavior

What happened, and what did you expect?

## Steps to reproduce

Give the starting prompt or minimal commands and a synthetic example if possible.
Do not upload private fields, particle cohorts, model checkpoints, credentials,
tokens, account records or unreviewed chat/setup logs.

## Relevant versions and scope

- ESA version:
- OS and Python version (Python 3.11+ is required):
- AI client and version (Codex / Claude Code):
- Runtime profile (full / analysis / cards), if known:
- New project or existing project:
- Does the helper verification pass? Does an actual client ESA tool call work?

## Sanitized error or evidence

Include the relevant short error and what you already tried. Share only reviewed
content. For a scientific tool, state units, coordinate/reference conventions and
the numerical criterion involved, avoiding facility-specific identifiers.

Security concerns should use the private contact in SECURITY.md.
